title: No eligible banking provider
detail: No banking provider is currently available to service a EUR virtual account for this customer.
resolution: Check the currency first: this is fixable when the currency is the cause. Call `GET /v2/customers/{customerId}/features/requirements?type=VIRTUAL_ACCOUNT` and read `allowedValues` on the `/asset/code` field — that list is the account currencies this endpoint accepts for the customer. If the currency you sent is not on that list, submit again with one that is. If it is on that list, no provider is available for this customer's jurisdiction, which is an operational availability limit and not a fixable request error.
